summary: GiftCookie is a specialized kind of Cookie that adds the gift-wrapping steps a normal cookie never needs. It inherits flavor, mixing, and baking from Cookie, and layers on its own box, ribbon, and gift note behavior.

lines.text: The extends keyword makes GiftCookie a Cookie, so it already has everything Cookie offers and only needs to describe what is different about a gift order.
A subclass constructor cannot set up the inherited parts itself, so it hands the flavor to Cookie's constructor first with super. Every GiftCookie is a fully built Cookie before any gift logic runs.
This is the one public entry point into the wrapping process, and it is the only part of the class the rest of the bakery application is meant to call.
Calling the three steps in order inside packageCookie is what guarantees the box comes before the ribbon and the note. Callers get the whole sequence or none of it.
The private modifier is encapsulation in practice: only GiftCookie can invoke this step, so no other part of the application can reorder or reinvent the wrapping process.

lines.code: System.out.println("Packaged " + getFlavor() + " cookie in a box.");
lines.text: The flavor field belongs to Cookie and is not directly reachable here, so the subclass reads it through the inherited getFlavor() method.
